jobs.description:
As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

jobs.occupation: Functional Analyst – System Integration & Data Flows
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Translate business and user requirements into detailed functional specifications, including features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
• Design and specify system-to-system interfaces, defining payload structures, error handling, and performance requirements for real-time contexts.
• Collaborate with architects, developers, and testers to ensure technical feasibility and consistency throughout the implementation phase.
• Investigate data and validate business rules using SQL to qualify defects and ensure high data quality.
• Manage project documentation and participate in defect reviews, UAT campaigns, and release activities.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of professional experience in functional analysis, including the production of functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
• You possess 2+ years of experience within traffic management systems or similar operational environments such as logistics, aviation, or utilities.
• You bring proven experience specifying system-to-system integrations using REST, SOAP, JSON, or XML.
• You're able to write SQL queries independently for data investigation, including SELECT, JOIN, and aggregation.
• You possess knowledge of interface modeling and protocols such as message-based or event-based architectures.
• You are fluent in English with at least a B2 level of Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with process and interaction modeling using BPMN, UML, or use cases.
• Knowledge of OpenAPI, XSD, or conceptual data modeling.
• Participation in UAT campaigns, defect triage, or migration activities.

• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent.

Experience with electronics, optics or precision manufacturing is an advantage, but you do not need to be an electronics specialist. Motivated candidates with a technical background and limited production experience are also welcome to apply.
